business_summary: Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd., operates as a fluid control solutions company in Japan and internationally. The company offers self-priming and multistage centrifugal, de-foaming/degassing, multistage and enhanced self-priming, turbine, process, centrifugal, double suction volute, and mixed-flow volute pumps. It also provides non-water hammer check valves; wafer-type check valves; constant flow valves; float-type regulator valves; and pilot-type regulator valves, including constant pressure, constant flow rate, liquid level-1/level-2 regulator, safety, pressure sustaining, differential pressure regulator, and emergency shutoff valves. In addition, the company offers special alloys and parts, such as special stainless steel, seawater resistant stainless steel, casting parts, and Yokota mechanical seals, as well as installation, piping, and inspection services. Further, it provides defoaming and degassing, aquarium, irrigation water supply, water and sewerage, water distribution, iron and steel work, tanker cargo handling, construction, seawater intake, slurry self-priming, snow removal, and undersea tunnel solutions. It serves government and municipal offices; and various companies in the agriculture, forestry, fishery, mining, construction, construction machine, food, beverage, steel, non-ferrous metal, industrial and household appliance, communication, industrial equipment, precision instrument, shipbuilding, vehicle, textile, paper, printing, oil, chemical, pharmaceutical, rubber product, glass, cement, electric power generation, gas, and aquarium sectors. The company was formerly known as Yokota Pump Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in 1959. Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.
